cases.english_scenario: A gives X to B; B independently gives Y to A
cases.distinction: No evidence of a bargained exchange

cases.english_scenario: A gives X to B in return for Y; B gives Y to A
A offers X for Y but B refuses
A and B agree to exchange X and Y tomorrow
A delivers X to B; B promises to supply Y later
A offers X for money; B agrees and pays; X has not been delivered
cases.distinction: Payment does not entail goods delivery

cases.english_scenario: A delivers X to B; B transfers agreed money to A
A temporarily gives X to B, who is obliged to return X
cases.distinction: Same item expected to be returned, not two distinct reciprocal goods

cases.english_scenario: A takes X from a table and carries it toward B
cases.distinction: No transfer of availability to B established

cases.english_scenario: A sends a message to B; B does not understand its content
A transfers ownership of X to B but a courier carries X
cases.distinction: Ownership transfer does not entail A physically transporting X

cases.english_scenario: A and B each send a payment to one another without agreement
cases.distinction: Two transfers do not entail coordinated exchange

cases.english_scenario: B receives X in return for providing Y to A
cases.distinction: Switching viewpoint preserves the same underlying event

cases.english_scenario: A is authorized to exchange X but never performs it

cases.distinction: Movement phase does not entail transfer completion
